extraPrompt.title: Extra system prompt
extraPrompt.description: Persistent preferences used when no prompt profile is selected below. Kept for settings saved by earlier versions.

promptProfiles.title: Prompt profiles
promptProfiles.description: Named writing preferences. Add, rename, edit, reorder and remove rows here; the selected profile replaces the Extra system prompt above. Output constraints still apply.

defaultPrompt.title: Default prompt profile
defaultPrompt.description: Name of the prompt profile to use. Blank uses Extra system prompt. This Project value overrides the Global one; leave it blank in a project to inherit the global choice.
